IFTTD, c'est le podcast pour les dévelop: IFTTD is the podcast for developers — not to learn to code, but to understand what it means to do the job. Each episode starts from a theme — tech, career, architecture, AI, ethics, management, burnout, mentoring — and takes the time to dig into it seriously with an expert guest. Far from "Tuesday tips": here, the developer is treated as a human being. With doubts, choices, and sometimes existential bugs.
Derrière le micro, Bruno Soulez — dévelo: Behind the mic is Bruno Soulez — developer, entrepreneur, speaker — who created the podcast to do his own tech watch and has never stopped since. Episodes run between 1h and 1h30: sober, stripped back, no intrusive jingles. The star is the guest and what they have to teach. A podcast you listen to when you're willing to slow down.
Cette fois, c'est Lolo qui interroge Ale: This time Lolo interviews Alex — and on this subject, Alex has plenty to say. IFTTD is the second podcast he discovered about his profession, after Electro Monkey, and he has never stopped listening to it. The verdict comes fast: it's his favourite dev podcast.
Ce qui le distingue ? La richesse des th: What sets it apart? The richness of its themes — languages, technical debt, AI, hiring, ethics — and above all the way it treats the developer not as a code-producing machine, but as someone with real questions about their job, their career, their balance. The long format (1h–1h30) isn't for everyone, but for those willing to slow down, it's an investment that pays off.
